summary: Frontend E2E test of the common site logo (header/footer/mobile drawer/admin/favicon/apple-touch-icon) driven by Pages → 'En-tête et onglet' → 'Logo du site'. All requested flows pass: default state, upload + preview before save (no site change before save), save propagates to /, /boutique, /a-propos, mobile 390 + drawer, admin dashboard and /admin/login; favicon + apple icon point to the same /api/media URL (200); reset ('Texte d'origine') + save restores logo-176.png / favicon-32.png and the header doc fields are {} again. Logo stays 44x44 desktop and mobile, no horizontal overflow. Smoke (home, boutique 6 cards, product buy button disabled until consent, contact form) OK.

issues: A non-square image (e.g. product-desk.jpg 900px wide) appears letterboxed inside the 44px box (object-contain). That's expected, but nothing in the UI warns about it apart from the label text 'image carrée'. You could add a short hint or offer a crop.

critical_code_review_comments: SitePagesPanel FaviconPreview hardcodes '/images/logo-176.png' instead of importing DEFAULT_LOGO from components/Logo.jsx (small DRY issue).

backend/tests/test_site_content.py restores site_content by re-inserting a snapshot. While it ran at the same time as this UI test, it silently overwrote my admin save (first attempt looked like a lost save). Avoid running that pytest at the same time as manual or UI tests.
Preview responses show 'access-control-allow-origin: *' (CORS_ORIGINS='*' with STRIPE_MODE=test). This is expected in preview; the production rule is covered by unit tests.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 media images (product-desk.jpg) to the media collection. The header logo was set and then reset; the final site_content 'header' fields are {} with no favicon field.
